newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-ECUADOR CLOSE TO UPSET AGAINST ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ECUADOR CLOSE TO UPSET AGAINST ARGENTINA.

text.p: Ecuador came close to scoring an upset against Argentina as the teams played to a 0-0 draw in their Copa America group A match on Wednesday.
Ecuador created several clearcut second half chances in a game featuring two teams that brought some regular internationals to the tournament but rested their star players.
Striker Eduardo Hurtado had a shot dramatically cleared off the line and was narrowly wide with a diving header in a match played at 2,500 metres above sea level.

Argentina goalkeeper Ignacio Gonzalez, currently serving a three-match World Cup ban for headbutting a Bolivian player during a match in April, also was forced to parry away a stinging drive by Wellington Sanchez.
It was a familiar story for the ever-improving Ecuadoreans, whose approach work was neat but who were ineffective in the last third of the field.
Argentina had one effort cleared off the line by Luis Capurro in the second half but generally can consider themselves lucky to take a point after yet another disjointed performance.
The game improved after halftime following a first half which is best not talked about.

Most of the 12 teams have left either some or all of their regular players behind, as the Copa is sandwiched between the regions's World Cup qualifying matches. Ecuador's regular coach Francisco Maturana is among those absent and has handed the reigns to his assistant Luis Fernando Suarez.
Paraguay, who beat Chile 1-0 in a match played immediately before in the same stadium, lead the group after the opening day of the tournament.

Argentina - 10-Ignacio Gonzalez, 13-Jorge Martinez, 5- Rodolfo Cardozo, 16-Mauricio Pellegrino, 20-Pablo Rotchen, 22- Gustavo Zapata, 8-Marcelo Delgado, 11-Claudio Husain, 12-Gustavo Lopez (9-Marcelo Gallardo, 46), 6-Raul Cardozo, 7-Julio Cruz (4- Jose Luis Calderon, 60).

Ecuador - 1-Francisco Cevallos, 17-Juan Burbano, 5-Maximo Tenorio, 6-Luis Capurro, 8-Hector Carabali, 4-Edmundo Mendez, 16-Eduardo Smith, 18-Edison Maldonado (20-Ariel Graziani, 50), 7-Wellington Sanchez, 10-Jose Gavica, 19-Kleber Chala (9-Eduardo Hurtado, 50).
